title: Sword Shrine Guardian
description: A moody isometric 3D action game built with three.js. Take up a spirit blade at a mist-shrouded shrine: read enemy telegraphs, parry to open execution windows, dodge unblockable slams, slash incoming orbs out of the air, and break the stone guardian's posture across a two-phase boss fight. Pick one of three upgrades after every cleared wave to forge your own build.
controls: WASD to move. J or left-click to attack (3-hit combo, third hit is heavy). K or right-click to parry — a successful parry opens an execution window; press attack to execute. Space to dodge with invincibility frames. After each wave pick 1 of 3 upgrades (click or press 1/2/3). Touch controls supported on mobile.
author: LightGame
